reminders.title: Payment reminders
reminders.lead: Eunomia speaks up by itself when an invoice's payment falls due or is overdue. Every user gets a mail about exactly the invoices they may see in the app. An invoice falling due is announced once; an overdue one repeats at the interval set.

retention.title: Retention
retention.lead: Deleted records stay in the trash until someone removes them there for good. With a retention period, Eunomia does it by itself: whatever has been in the trash longer than the number of days set is deleted permanently once a day — and with it whatever hangs below it and is deleted itself. Deleted users go after the same period. This cannot be undone; the dry run shows beforehand what it affects.
retention.legacyHint: Entries from before the trash existed have no deletion date and are never caught by the period — they stay to be deleted by hand.
retention.daysError: Please enter a number between 1 and 3650.
retention.dryRunSentence: Dry run: {what} older than {days} would be deleted permanently.
retention.held: {n} entry remains: something active still hangs on it. | {n} entries remain: something active still hangs on them.
